subject: Post-demo scout: buyer map + legal routing plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@medisphere.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & ask: stakeholder map + legal routing

Hi Sophie — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we have alignment across teams.

What we covered (short):
- Demo: intent-based retrieval + streaming responses for clinician workflows; latency targets and token cost scenarios we ran through.
- Key decision drivers you called out: ease of integration, data residency for PHI, and predictable unit economics.

Asks / open items we need to land to progress contracting:
1) Economic buyer & procurement cadence: can you confirm the person who will sign/approve spend and the typical procurement timeline?
2) Security/legal contacts: Who should we send the NDA to, and who will own SOC2/SI/architecture questions?
3) Contract routing preference: do you prefer we send NDA -> MSA -> DPA (sequential), or NDA and DPA in parallel? Any internal SLAs for redline turn-times?

I'll attach our standard NDA and a short Legal handoff checklist (for your procurement/legal team to review). If you can reply with the stakeholders + an approximate timeline, we'll map owners on our side and send the NDA for signature.

Proposed next steps (mine):
- Today: confirm stakeholders and procurement email
- EOD (our side): send NDA via DocuSign once we have the recipient
- Next week: 30-min alignment between Redwood legal and your counsel to agree sequence and turn-times

Attachments: 20271101-nda-template.pdf (stub), legal-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

— Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@medisphere.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & ask: stakeholder map + legal routing

Hi Mina — great demo; appreciate the clear recap. Answers below.

Stakeholders:
- Economic buyer: Caroline Price, VP Product — caroline.price@medisphere.com (will sign if scope <= $200k; above that goes to CFO)
- Security lead: Raj Patel, Head of Security — raj.patel@medisphere.com (will own SOC2/arch questions)
- Procurement: procurement@medisphere.com (small team; usually does PO & vendor intake)
- Legal counsel we use for initial redlines: Mike Lee, Daniels Legal — m.lee@daniels-legal.com

Procurement cadence: typical internal window is 4–8 weeks once we have an NDA in place; for pilots we sometimes compress to ~3 weeks. If we can keep NDAs and DPAs simple, that speeds things up.

Routing preference: NDA first (simple standard), then MSA redlines. DPA can be worked in parallel but would need security sign-off.

I'll loop in Raj and procurement in a follow-up so you have direct contacts. Please send the NDA to me and procurement@medisphere.com; I will route to Caroline if numbers look right.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Grant
Director, Product Strategy | Medisphere Health
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Grant <sophie@medisphere.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Owner map + timeline request (Medisphere) — please confirm owners

Team — following Sophie's note, here's my proposed owner map and estimated turn-times. Please confirm and flag if someone else should own.

Proposed owners:
- NDA send & DocuSign tracking: Ben Carter (I'll have Ben send to sophie + procurement)
- Security questionnaire & DPA technical liaison: Rishi Malhotra (lead SRE/eng answers)
- MSA redline lead & legal handoff: Lauren Bishop (contracts manager)

Estimated turn times (ask these are our commitments to coordinate with Medisphere):
- NDA (DocuSign): 1–2 business days after send
- MSA first-pass response: 4 business days for internal review + 3 business days for legal to submit redlines (so ~7 business days total to first pass)
- DPA: 3–5 business days once security and legal align

Attachments: legal-checklist.xlsx (mapping fields to owners).

Ben/Rishi/Lauren — can you acknowledge and I will send the NDA once Sophie confirms the procurement recipient?

— Mina
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Grant <sophie@medisphere.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Owner map + timeline request (Medisphere) — confirm

Acknowledged. Owner confirmations and quick plan: 

- I will send the NDA via DocuSign to sophie@medisphere.com and procurement@medisphere.com today (Link: https://www.docusign.com/tx/abc123) — goal: signature in 1–2 business days. Attachment: first-pass-msaredline.docx (stub)
- Rishi — please prepare the initial security questionnaire draft and a short note on any PHI/data-residency requirements (we will include that in the DPA conversation).
- Lauren — once NDA is executed, please pull the template MSA and do a first-pass internal redline within 4 business days. I propose we commit to 3 business days for legal to return colors back to customer afterwards.

Turn-time commitments (from Redwood): NDA 2bd, MSA first pass (internal): 4bd, MSA to customer redline: +3bd, DPA: 3bd after security sign-off. If Medisphere requests compressed SLAs, we'll escalate.

I'll send the NDA now and BCC Mina for tracking.

— Ben
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@medisphere.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medisphere.com>, Medisphere Procurement <procurement@medisphere.com>, Mike Lee <m.lee@daniels-legal.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & ask: stakeholder map + legal routing

Thanks, all. Good plan — we've added Mike Lee from Daniels Legal (copied) as our counsel for the redline phase. Procurement has visibility and will prioritize the NDA.

We'll accept NDA first; please send via DocuSign to procurement@medisphere.com and I will route to Caroline for approval if the scope hits sign-off thresholds. For the MSA, we'd prefer a single redline pass (we'll try to keep comments consolidated). DPA can be worked in parallel with Raj and Rishi coordinating.

Proposed next meeting: 30-minute legal handoff next Tuesday (Nov 9) at 10am PT — happy to take a calendar invite.

Attachment from our side: PO-requirements.pdf (stub) — procurement flagged standard PO terms they need in the MSA.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Sophie
